column4: AS-IS has no namespace (implicit global, Unity script); TO-BE wraps the class in `namespace HeadlessDCGO.Engine.Assets.Scripts.Script;` and adds usings for CardEffectCommons/Headless.Bridge/Headless.Choices/Headless.Runtime/Headless.Services/Headless.State plus a `Commons` alias for CardEffectCommons.CardEffectCommons; C# project organization requires namespacing across a multi-assembly build, AS-IS Unity script has no equivalent need

AS-IS is a Unity MonoBehaviour with an implicit public parameterless constructor, instantiated by scene/Inspector wiring, exposed as a plain public field on GManager; TO-BE gives it a private constructor plus `public static AutoProcessing For(EngineContext context)` / `public static AutoProcessing ForCutIn(EngineContext context)` factories that register/retrieve the instance on `EngineContext` (`RegisterService`/`TryGetService`), and a nested `CutInInstanceHolder` wrapper class (TO-BE:49-57) with no AS-IS counterpart, to distinguish the two singleton roles (`autoProcessing` vs `autoProcessing_CutIn` on GManager). No Unity scene/Inspector component instantiation exists in headless; the EngineContext-scoped service registry substitutes for it
`[SerializeField] bool SkipSameEffect;` field dropped entirely; grep -a across DCGO/Assets/Scripts/ shows only the declaration line itself, no reader anywhere in AS-IS (dead field in AS-IS too)

AS-IS `public List<MultipleSkills> multipleSkills = new List<MultipleSkills>();` is a directly-settable public field; TO-BE makes it a get-only property (`public List<MultipleSkills> multipleSkills => _multipleSkills;`) over a `private readonly` backing field, so external reassignment of the whole list (`autoProcessing.multipleSkills = ...`) is no longer possible

AS-IS returns `null` when every pooled `MultipleSkills` is in use (pool is a fixed Inspector-provisioned list, never grown). TO-BE, on the same exhaustion, constructs a brand-new `MultipleSkills(_context)`, appends it to `_multipleSkills`, and returns it — the getter can never return null in the port, changing the null/non-null contract callers (e.g. TriggeredSkillProcess's `if (availableMultipleSkills != null)`) observe. No Unity scene-instantiated component pool exists to draw from in headless; lazy construction substitutes it

`card.PermanentOfThisCard()` (instance method returning `Permanent`) becomes `ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard(card)` (static resolver). In the port, `CardSource.PermanentOfThisCard()` still exists but now returns a different type, `PermanentView` (CardSource.cs:56), not a nullable `Permanent`; callers that need a real nullable `Permanent` (like PutStackedSkill) must instead call the separate static `ICardEffect.ResolvePermanentOfThisCard` (ICardEffect.cs:462)

`if (card == GManager.instance.attackProcess.SecurityDigimon)` (CardSource reference equality) becomes `if (GManager.instance.attackProcess.SecurityDigimon is { } securityDigimon && card.InstanceId == securityDigimon)` (id equality). AS-IS `AttackProcess.SecurityDigimon` is `public CardSource SecurityDigimon`; port `AttackProcess.SecurityDigimon` is `public HeadlessEntityId? SecurityDigimon` — the field's type itself changed

AS-IS body opens with `yield return ContinuousController.instance.StartCoroutine(ShrinkSecurityDigimonDisplay());` then brackets the whole pipeline in `GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.IsSelecting = true;` / `= false;`. TO-BE's AutoProcessCheck has the ShrinkSecurityDigimonDisplay call site removed — see the dedicated ABSENT row for that method (AS-IS:730-747) for why

`GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.IsSelecting = true;` / `= false;` bracketing the whole AutoProcessCheck pipeline is entirely absent from TO-BE. `TurnStateMachine.IsSelecting` still exists in the port (TurnStateMachine.cs:50) and is set/cleared elsewhere in the port (e.g. AttackProcess.cs:231/246/365, CardController.cs:3727/4006/4134), so nothing prevents AutoProcessCheck from doing the same; it simply does not

The entire `ShrinkSecurityDigimonDisplay()` method (and both its in-file call sites at AS-IS:126 and :574) is absent from the TO-BE tree — grep -rn "ShrinkSecurityDigimonDisplay" src/HeadlessDCGO.Engine/ returns zero hits anywhere, including its 8 other AS-IS call sites in CardController.cs/CardObjectController.cs. AS-IS body reads `GManager.instance.GetComponent<Effects>().ShowUseHandCard.gameObject.activeSelf` and `.ShowUseHandCard.cardSource`; the port's `Effects.ShowUseHandCard` (Effects.cs:118) is a bare `object?` stub with no `.gameObject`/`.cardSource` members, and there is no `GetComponent<Effects>()` call anywhere in the port tree (grep count 0)
`public bool IsRuleProcessing { get; set; } = false;` drops the explicit `= false` initializer in TO-BE; default(bool) is false either way, no behavioral difference

TO-BE inserts a guard absent from AS-IS: `if (!permanent.TopCard.HasDefinition) { return false; }` before the `IsExistOnBreedingArea` check. `CardSource.HasDefinition` (CardSource.cs:1000, `=> Definition is not null`) has no AS-IS counterpart; it is a data-definition-lookup guard since AS-IS cards are always backed by a compiled prefab/component with no equivalent "undefined card" state

TO-BE inserts a guard absent from AS-IS: `if (permanent.IsDigimon && !permanent.TopCard.IsDigiEgg && !permanent.IsDpDefined) { return false; }` before the `permanent.DP < 0` check. `Permanent.IsDpDefined` (Permanent.cs:131) has no AS-IS counterpart — a data-definition guard for DP resolution, absent from AS-IS's always-defined Unity card fields
TO-BE inserts a guard absent from AS-IS: `if (!permanent.IsDpDefined) { return false; }` before the `permanent.DP == 0` check — same IsDpDefined guard as IsNotHavingDP

`GManager.instance.attackProcess.IsAttacking`/`.AttackingPermanent` (global singleton field access) becomes `AttackProcess attackProcess = AttackProcess.For(_context); attackProcess.IsAttacking`/`.AttackingPermanent` (per-context factory lookup); `AttackProcess.For(EngineContext)` (AttackProcess.cs:23) replaces the GManager.instance global singleton

`permanent.LinkedCards.Any(source => !source.CanLinkToTargetPermanent(permanent, false, true))` becomes `permanent.LinkedCards.Any(source => source.LinkConditionOf() is not null && !source.CanLinkToTargetPermanent(permanent, false, true))` — an added `LinkConditionOf() is not null` guard narrows which linked cards can trip the lacking-condition check. `CardSource.LinkConditionOf()` (CardSource.cs:1628) has no AS-IS counterpart; AS-IS folds the equivalent check entirely inside CanLinkToTargetPermanent

Access modifier only: AS-IS `bool IsDigimonLackLinkCount(...)` (implicit private, default C# member access) becomes explicit `private bool IsDigimonLackLinkCount(...)`; body identical, accessibility unchanged (implicit private == explicit private)
Access modifier only: AS-IS `bool IsPermanentFaceDown(...)` (implicit private) becomes explicit `private bool IsPermanentFaceDown(...)`; body identical, accessibility unchanged

`public IEnumerator RuleProcess()` (no return value, no cancellation) becomes `public async Task<bool> RuleProcess(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`; TO-BE opens with `using AmbientMatchContext.Scope _ruleScope = AmbientMatchContext.Enter(_context);`, absent from AS-IS — this threads the per-match EngineContext to code paths that still resolve state via GManager.instance-style global access within this call tree, a substitute for Unity's single implicit scene context

`while (DoRuleProcess())` gains, inside the loop body, `cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();` — cooperative cancellation with no Unity coroutine engine to abort via scene teardown, no AS-IS counterpart

`bool progressed = false;` per-pass accumulator with no AS-IS counterpart — AS-IS's loop re-scans board state via the pure predicate DoRuleProcess() each pass and keeps no progress flag at all (confirmed in docs/audit/coroutine_handsites.md A-01: "bool is port-only")

AS-IS: `yield return ...StartCoroutine(EndGameProcess()); if (GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.endGame) yield break;` — leaves `IsRuleProcessing` at `true` on the way out (never reset before the `yield break`, since DoRuleProcess's first check is `if (IsRuleProcessing) return false;`, permanently blocking further passes after any game-ending pass). TO-BE explicitly resets it: `progressed |= EndGameProcess(); if (_context.RuleQueryService.IsTerminal()) { IsRuleProcessing = false; return true; }`
`GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.endGame` (state-machine boolean field) becomes `_context.RuleQueryService.IsTerminal()` (query-service call) — query-service abstraction replaces the AS-IS field

Each `yield return ...StartCoroutine(StageProcess())` (void IEnumerator, nothing read back) becomes `progressed |= await StageProcess(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false)` for TrashNonDigimonPermanentProcess/TrashNoDPPermanentProcess/DigimonLackDPProcess/DigimonLackLinkConditionProcess/CardFaceDownProcess — each stage method's new `bool` return is a port-only invention consumed only to build `progressed` (docs/audit/coroutine_handsites.md A-02..A-05, A-07)

AS-IS `yield return ...StartCoroutine(BattleWithoutDigimon())` / `...DigimonLackLinkMaxCountProcess())` are bare void-IEnumerator calls with nothing read back. TO-BE reads back `progressed |= BattleWithoutDigimon();` and, for the link-max stage, destructures `(bool linkMaxProgressed, bool linkMaxParked) = await DigimonLackLinkMaxCountProcess(cancellationToken)...; if (linkMaxParked) { IsRuleProcessing = false; return true; }` — an early-exit ("parked") path that stops the whole RuleProcess loop mid-pass when a player choice becomes pending, with no AS-IS analogue (AS-IS's coroutine simply suspends at the nested yield and resumes the same foreach in place; docs/audit/coroutine_handsites.md B-05: "the original just suspends in place")

AS-IS unconditionally loops back to `while (DoRuleProcess())` after `IsRuleProcessing = false;`. TO-BE adds `progressedAny |= progressed; if (!progressed) { _context.LogSink.Warn("...RuleProcess pass made no progress while DoRuleProcess reports work; yielding."); break; }` — a stall-detection early `break` out of the while loop with no AS-IS counterpart, plus a final `return progressedAny;` (AS-IS returns nothing, it's void IEnumerator)

`GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players.Count(player => player.IsLose)` becomes `Players().Count(playerId => _context.PlayerStatusController.IsLose(playerId))` — global GameContext.Players field enumeration replaced by the private `Players()` helper (TO-BE:608-609, backed by `_context.TurnController.Current.PlayerOrder`) plus `PlayerStatusController.IsLose(HeadlessPlayerId)`

`CardEffectCommons.HasMatchConditionPermanent(condition, isContainBreedingArea)` — a public static method defined in a different AS-IS file, `DCGO/Assets/Scripts/Script/CardEffectCommons/GameContextDeterminarion.cs:641` — becomes a call to a new `private bool HasMatchConditionPermanent(...)` defined inside AutoProcessing.cs itself (TO-BE:581-606). The port's own `CardEffectCommons.cs` only carries a differently-shaped 3-arg overload that additionally requires a `CardSource card` (CardEffectCommons.cs:1800); the AS-IS 2-arg (`Func<Permanent,bool>`, `bool`) overload used here has no matching overload in the port's CardEffectCommons, so the logic is duplicated locally using `PlayersForTurnPlayer()`/`GetBattleAreaPermanents()`/`GetBreedingAreaPermanents()` (ZoneMover-based per-player zone reads) instead of AS-IS's `Players.Map(player => player.GetBattleAreaPermanents()/GetFieldPermanents()).Flat().Some(condition)`
`if (IsAttackerNotADigimon()) { //return true; }` — dead branch (commented-out `return true;`) preserved identically in TO-BE; no behavioral difference, noted for hunk coverage

TO-BE adds a guard absent from AS-IS at method entry: `if (_context.RuleQueryService.IsTerminal()) { return false; }` before iterating players — a RuleQueryService re-entrancy guard, no AS-IS field for this early-out

`foreach (Player player in GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players) { if (player.IsLose) {...} }` becomes `foreach (HeadlessPlayerId playerId in Players()) { if (!_context.PlayerStatusController.IsLose(playerId)) { continue; } ...}` — same substrate substitution as DoRuleProcess (GameContext.Players/Player.IsLose → Players()/PlayerStatusController.IsLose)

AS-IS calls `GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.EndGame(player.Enemy, false)` (winner, Surrendered) or `EndGame(null, false)` for a mutual loss, then `yield break`. TO-BE computes `bothLose` via `new Player(_context, playerId).Enemy?.PlayerId` + `PlayerStatusController.IsLose(enemy)`, then calls `ITerminalOutcomeSink.SetTerminalOutcome(winnerId, isDraw, reasonString)` if the RuleQueryService implements that interface, else falls back to `ITerminalStateController.SetTerminal(true)` — no AS-IS analogue for either interface dispatch. `TurnStateMachine.EndGame`'s own scene-cleanup / Photon room property reset (GManager.CloseWhenEndingGameObjects, PhotonNetwork.CurrentRoom.SetCustomProperties) has no headless substrate to run against
TO-BE adds `_context.LogSink.Info($"[AutoProcessing] EndGameProcess terminal: ...")` with no AS-IS counterpart call at this site

`GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer.Map(player => player.GetBreedingAreaPermanents().Filter(IsNotDigimonInBreeding)).Flat()` becomes `PlayersForTurnPlayer().SelectMany(player => GetBreedingAreaPermanents(player).Where(IsNotDigimonInBreeding)).ToList()` — GameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer/Player.GetBreedingAreaPermanents() replaced by the new private PlayersForTurnPlayer()/GetBreedingAreaPermanents(HeadlessPlayerId) helpers

AS-IS runs 4 sequential coroutines per permanent: `DiscardEvoRoots()`, `GManager.instance.GetComponent<Effects>().ShowCardEffect(new List<CardSource>{cardSource}, "Cards put to trash", true, true)`, `CardObjectController.RemoveField(permanent)`, `CardObjectController.AddTrashCard(cardSource)`. TO-BE's `DirectTrashPermanentAsync` calls only `permanent.DiscardEvoRoots(...)` then `_context.ZoneMover.MoveAsync(new ZoneMoveRequest(...), ...)` — RemoveField+AddTrashCard (both still exist as static methods on CardObjectController.cs:176/217) are bypassed in favor of a single ZoneMover.MoveAsync request

`GManager.instance.GetComponent<Effects>().ShowCardEffect(new List<CardSource>{cardSource}, "Cards put to trash", true, true)` call is dropped — no call site at all in DirectTrashPermanentAsync, though `Effects.ShowCardEffect` still exists as a no-op Task stub (Effects.cs:86) and is callable

`IEnumerator TrashNonDigimonPermanentProcess()` (void) becomes `private async Task<bool> TrashNonDigimonPermanentProcess(CancellationToken)` returning a `progressed` flag set whenever a permanent was actually trashed — AS-IS keeps no such flag (docs/audit/coroutine_handsites.md A-02)

Same substrate substitution as TrashNonDigimonPermanentProcess: Players_ForTurnPlayer/GetBattleAreaPermanents() enumeration swap and RemoveField+AddTrashCard collapsed into DirectTrashPermanentAsync (BattleArea zone)
Same ShowCardEffect call drop as TrashNonDigimonPermanentProcess, and the same port-only `progressed` return added to `private async Task<bool> TrashNoDPPermanentProcess(CancellationToken)`
Players_ForTurnPlayer/GetBattleAreaPermanents() substrate swap (as above)

AS-IS's `yield return ...StartCoroutine(new DestroyPermanentsClass(...).Destroy())` reads nothing back; TO-BE reads `destroyPermanents.DestroyedPermanents.Count >= 1` off the same instance after `await Destroy(...)` to build its `bool` return — `DestroyPermanentsClass.DestroyedPermanents` exists in AS-IS but the AS-IS coroutine never consults it at this call site

`GManager.instance.attackProcess.AttackingPermanent`/`.DefendingPermanent`/`.HasDefender`/`.IsEndAttack` (global singleton) becomes `AttackProcess attackProcess = AttackProcess.For(_context); attackProcess....` (per-context factory) — same AttackProcess.For(_context) substitution as IsAttackerNotADigimon

AS-IS sets `attackProcess.IsEndAttack = true;` unconditionally whenever `!AttackingPermanent.IsDigimon` (and again whenever `DefendingPermanent == null && HasDefender`), with no guard on the current value. TO-BE adds `&& !attackProcess.IsEndAttack` to each condition and tracks a `bool progressed` set only on the transition, returned to the caller — AS-IS has no such flag and reassigns unconditionally each pass; final IsEndAttack state is equivalent (still ends up true) but the added condition guard is a code-shape change with no AS-IS counterpart
Players_ForTurnPlayer/GetFieldPermanents() substrate swap (as above)

`permanent.LinkedCards.FindAll(source => !source.CanLinkToTargetPermanent(permanent, false))` becomes `permanent.LinkedCards.FindAll(source => source.LinkConditionOf() is not null && !source.CanLinkToTargetPermanent(permanent, false))` — same `LinkConditionOf()` guard addition as IsDigimonLackLinkCondition

`yield return ...StartCoroutine(new ITrashLinkCards(permanent, selectedCards, null).TrashLinkCards())` (nothing read back) becomes `await new ITrashLinkCards(...).TrashLinkCards(cancellationToken)...; progressed = true;` — `progressed` is unconditionally set true whenever any permanent was in the list, a port-only flag with no AS-IS counterpart

AS-IS's `foreach (Permanent permanent in LackLinkCountPermanents) { yield return ...StartCoroutine(permanent.RemoveLinkedCard(...)); }` processes every over-linked permanent in the list in one pass (a nested player-selection coroutine, if any, suspends and resumes the same foreach). TO-BE's version checks `if (_context.ChoiceController.Current.IsPending) { return (true, true); }` after each `RemoveLinkedCard` await and, if a choice is now pending, abandons the remaining permanents in the list and returns `Parked = true` immediately — remaining over-linked permanents are left for the next external re-entry into RuleProcess rather than finished in the same pass. Has no AS-IS analogue (docs/audit/coroutine_handsites.md: "the original simply suspends inside SelectCardEffect.Activate() and the coroutine resumes in place")
Same substrate substitution as the other Trash*Process methods: Players_ForTurnPlayer/GetBattleAreaPermanents() enumeration swap and RemoveField+AddTrashCard collapsed into DirectTrashPermanentAsync
Same ShowCardEffect call drop and port-only `progressed` return added to `private async Task<bool> CardFaceDownProcess(CancellationToken)` as the other Trash*Process methods

Six new private helper methods with no AS-IS counterpart, collectively replacing the AS-IS pattern of calling instance methods on `Player` (`player.GetBattleAreaPermanents()`, `player.GetFieldPermanents()`, `player.GetBreedingAreaPermanents()`) reached via `GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer`. `GetZonePermanents` reads `_context.ZoneMover` cast to `IZoneStateReader` and constructs `new Permanent(_context, cardId, player)` per id — no GameContext/Player singleton chain exists in the port; ZoneMover-based per-id zone reads substitute for it throughout this file

AS-IS: inside `if (Passed && TurnPhase==Main)`, branches on `if (GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.TurnPlayer.PlayerID == 0) { gameContext.Memory = 3; } else { gameContext.Memory = -3; }`.
